description: List slow queries from pg_stat_statements, ordered by mean execution time.

branchId.description: Optional ID of the branch to inspect; when omitted, the project's default branch is used.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database to inspect; when omitted, the project's default database is used.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of slow queries to return, clamped to between 1 and 100; defaults to 10.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project that owns the database.

name: list_slow_queries
